postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU Universal DataBase Sep. 2025 list, updated 20 August 2026, includes Angola among countries which do not require postal codes. The UPU Angola addressing sheet and current Correios de Angola station pages use street, locality and postal-box addressing without a postcode. A province, municipality, locality, station, postal-box number, route, AGID value or synthetic AO planning code is not an Angola postcode.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current postcode assignments exist to anchor postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon records. National, province, municipality, locality, office, route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as postal geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, street, house or building number, locality, municipality, province, postal-box number and country as separate fields. Do not insert a fabricated postcode into domestic addresses.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: A Caixa Postal/Apartado number is a rented secondary address object, not a postcode or postal area.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires separately rights-cleared civic-address identity and an explicit reviewed relation to point or footprint geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may return independently typed address context only under source-specific rights; they must never manufacture a postcode or postal surface.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. AO planning cells are not Correios de Angola assignments or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Reviewed operator, regulator and UPU pages are reference evidence. UPU copyright restrictions do not grant AGID processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights for a postal dataset.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO AO identity and Angola's territory; do not borrow codes or geometry from another jurisdiction.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, box holders, customer addresses, parcel observations, coordinates, buildings and query logs remain excluded absent explicit authority and minimisation.
postal_system.temporal_rule: No-postcode status is time-dependent; preserve retrieval time, edition, exact bytes and SHA-256 and re-check after the pending-country sweep or an official announcement.

stages.definition: Angola address-format inventory, draft country pack, synthetic planning cells and conformance fixtures only.
Digest-bound Correios de Angola, INACOM and UPU evidence that Angola currently does not require postal codes, plus rights, identity, address-format correction and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current authoritative Correios de Angola or competent public release establishing an Angola postcode system and a complete finite denominator of every assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The UPU Universal DataBase Sep. 2025 list updated 20 August 2026 currently says Angola does not require postal codes; absence is represented as none and does not satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon milestone. If a future system is introduced, every drawable code must reconcile to fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Country, province, municipality, locality, address, station, route, service area, postal box, building, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, AGID cell and synthetic AO planning code are prohibited proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real AO API/app, handling no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, failure and invalid geometry states, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, clear/re-search, and display of code, geometry kind, class, source, date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: AO metadata, no-postcode policy, corrected address format and synthetic planning fixtures only; no real AO Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual AO loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture an Angola postal polygon. Independently licensed context remains typed and source-qualified.
